name: Matěj Janovský — a wife named Marie and a son baptised in 1874, Malšice, Bohemia
researcher_question: Matěj Janovský, born about 1843, married Kateřina Votýpková at Malšice, Tábor, Bohemia on 27 October 1866. Who were his wife or wives, and which children were born to him?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 8, hint-samples.csv row 239, flags adds_spouse/adds_son, confidence 3). Draft transcribed from an 1874 Malšice Catholic baptism entry for a son Josef, naming the father Matěj Janovský and the mother only as Marie; unverified. The tree's only wife is Kateřina Votýpková, so a true match means a second marriage.
